    // basic uses of function literals with constructor overloads
    
    class C {
        constructor(x: string);
        constructor(x: number);
        constructor(x) { }
    }

        constructor(x: string);
        constructor(x: number);
        constructor(x) { }
    }

    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
        new(x: number): C;
    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
    } = C;
    ~~~~~
